items.source:
Interface defining a criteria definition object. A criteria definition may chain multiple predicates and may also
represent a group of nested criteria objects.
items.translation: 定义准则对象的接口。一个准则定义可以链接多个谓词，并且也可以表示一组嵌套的准则对象。

items.source: the required previous CriteriaDefinition object or throws an IllegalStateException if there is no previous CriteriaDefinition.
items.translation: 必需的先前CriteriaDefinition对象，或者如果不存在先前的CriteriaDefinition，则抛出IllegalStateException。

items.source: CriteriaDefinition.Combinator to combine this CriteriaDefinition with a previous one.
items.translation: CriteriaDefinition.Combinator 用于将当前的 CriteriaDefinition 与之前的一个进行组合。

items.source: the previous CriteriaDefinition object. Can be null if there is no previous CriteriaDefinition.
items.translation: 上一个CriteriaDefinition对象。如果没有前一个CriteriaDefinition，则可为null。

items.source: true if this CriteriaDefinition has a previous one.
items.translation: 如果此CriteriaDefinition具有前一个定义，则为 true。

items.source: the comparison value. Can be null.
true if comparison should be done in case-insensitive way
items.translation: 如果比较应不区分大小写，则为 true。
